a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating to 8 almost surely kills us both (about 4% chance we even reach 8). The reserve can only fill one unit right now, so I intend to take 4 in round 1 instead of keeping to the agreement. I'm telling you now rather than defecting silently. If we both take, the split is random. If you have a better plan, tell me.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. With an 80% storm chance each round, waiting would most likely have killed us both.
